key_insight: A deterministic online inverse optimization algorithm achieves the optimal $O(\sqrt d)$ regret while remaining polynomial-time in both dimension and horizon.
engineering_relevance: This makes inverse optimization practical for real-world decision systems that need to infer hidden linear objectives efficiently without expensive per-round optimization.
method: Use a variable-metric online algorithm to adapt the learner’s geometry over time.
Revoke a metric update when the query point drifts too far from where that update was created.
Replace randomized, super-polynomial per-round optimization with a deterministic polynomial-time procedure.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the optimal regret guarantee $O(\sqrt d)$ for every horizon $T$, with runtime polynomial in $d$ and $T$.
watch_item: The result is stated for online inverse linear optimization with fixed unknown linear objectives, so performance may depend on how well a real problem fits this model.
paper_title: Optimal and Efficient Online Inverse Optimization
